Questions & Help

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything about our Award Maker & Educational Tools.

Learn how teachers, homeschoolers, and parents utilize our free utilities to recognize student milestones and motivate learning.

How do I create and print a certificate using the Award Maker?

Enter the recipient's name, choose or type an award category, select a color theme (Royal Gold, Wattle Emerald, or Scholar Crimson), and click Print Certificate (A4) or Download PNG Image. No registration required.

Is the Cutech Certificate Generator 100% free?

Yes! It is completely free with zero hidden subscriptions, clean watermarks, and unlimited prints and downloads for teachers, parents, and schools.

Can I create custom certificates for subjects beyond reading?

Yes, select Custom Award Title in the award category dropdown to make certificates for STEM, writing, mathematics, sport, citizenship, or personal growth.

Our purpose

Why we exist

Literacy is more than a skill. It is a way into the world.

Cutech exists to make that way in clearer. We bring education and technology together to create learning experiences that are accessible, encouraging and built for real progress.

M

Our mission

Help more people become confident, capable readers and critical thinkers.

V

Our vision

A world where literacy creates possibility for everyone.

Our objectives

Three ways we move learning forward.

01

Improve access

Create digital learning experiences that are clear, inclusive and easier to use.

02

Strengthen confidence

Support steady progress through purposeful practice and encouraging experiences.

03

Build for impact

Develop initiatives with the potential to serve learners in Australia and beyond.

03

Our values

How we make
learning matter.

Our principles shape what we build, how we communicate and the impact we work towards.

01

Purpose before novelty

We use technology when it makes learning more effective, accessible or human.

02

Clarity builds trust

We communicate plainly, design intentionally and make learning approachable.

03

Progress compounds

We value consistent, evidence-aware improvement over quick fixes and empty claims.

04

People stay central

We build with respect for learners, families, educators and the communities around them.
